verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy logging docs say it can send proxy input, output and exceptions to many destinations, including OpenTelemetry, DataDog, Langfuse, Langsmith, S3/GCS/Azure buckets and custom callbacks. A per-request call_id supports tracing, and message redaction can be configured while metadata is still tracked. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the exports work in practice, and detailed evidence on trace structure and span content beyond a list of supported destinations.
